description: GitHub Flow keeps main ready to deploy and uses a short-lived branch for each change. A pull request provides review and automated checks before the change merges into main, after which the branch is deleted. With no separate develop or release branches, this strategy suits teams delivering small, frequent updates.

branches.label: main
branches.description: The single long-lived branch and always deployable. Everything merges here via pull request.

branches.label: feature/*
branches.description: A short-lived branch per change, created from main, opened as a pull request, and deleted after merge. No develop or release branches.
